findings.remediation: Every returned delta is backed by an equal same-call take() in the same currency; four-quadrant and partial-fill proofs are bound in the test evidence.
findings.summary: beforeSwapReturnDelta is enabled and always requires the highest review path.

findings.remediation: Disclosed as a deliberate trust boundary; on-chain quorum, spread and freshness checks bound the signer authority.
findings.summary: The oracle signature model accepts a fixed EOA signer and does not support ERC-1271 contract wallets.

findings.remediation: This application targets apply eligibility, not launch eligibility, and awaits maintainer guidance on chain handling.
findings.summary: Chain 1301 is application eligible, but the current Programmable launch runtime is integrated only with Ethereum Mainnet.

findings.remediation: Liabilities are keyed by poolId, currency and beneficiary with cross pool netting disabled; solvency is mutation tested across two pools sharing a quote currency.
findings.summary: One hook instance serves every registered pool, so custom accounting carries correlated exposure.

findings.remediation: Reported as blocked rather than passed; rerun the static analysis gate and bind its output before release consideration.
findings.summary: Slither was unavailable in the builder environment, so the static analysis gate did not run.
